primary_insight: The genuine remaining gap is the Transducer-Absence Class: science detects a signal from an invisible layer and names the layer dark instead of locating the converter. Dark oxygen currently names three unequal claims; the weakest (nodule electrolysis, Nature Geoscience Editor's Note 2026-04-08) is the policy object and was the load-bearing beam of the May 14 Dark Biosphere Hypothesis. Crustal radiolytic/biotic O2 (Ruff; New Yorker 2026-08-13; NASA OxyMoRon) is the stronger quieter phenomenon and is itself mechanistically unproved.
capability_gap_identified: No existing tool tracks scientific-name homonym collapse against evidential status and policy/hypothesis use in real time.
